The ledger deployment in the production namespace is experiencing issues due to a failed container.

### 2. Affected resources
- Pod/production/ledger-7d9f8c6b5-a1b2c — failed container ledger

### 3. Root cause
The root cause appears to be a failed container restart due to an unspecified error, as indicated by the BackOff event.

### 4. Causal chain
1. The deployment for ledger in the production namespace was deployed using Helm.
2. The deployment was configured to have 3 replicas.
3. One of the pods (ledger-7d9f8c6b5-a1b2c) in the deployment experienced a failure with the ledger container.
4. The failure caused the container to enter a BackOff state, triggering repeated attempts to restart the container.

- To investigate the cause of the container failure, you can check the logs of the failed container:
  ```
  kubectl logs -n production pod/ledger-7d9f8c6b5-a1b2c ledger
  ```

  ```
  kubectl scale deployment ledger -n production --replicas=1
  kubectl scale deployment ledger -n production --replicas=3
  ```
